sentences.text: No, a Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges on a floating rate loan granted for business purpose to an MSE, and the sanction date 15 March 2026 is on or after January 1, 2026.
The bank’s sanction letters state “2% of the amount prepaid,” but the applicable UCB direction says “A Tier 4 UCB shall not levy prepayment charges.”
